pantallas.en_uso: The display ({device}) is being used by another program, such as UsbPCMonitor. Close it so Luzeira can use it.
pantallas.confirmar_rev_a: I found a display on {device}, but I can't tell which model it is. Confirm it's a Turing / UsbPCMonitor 3.5" (revision A) to continue, or choose another model under “Display”.
pantallas.confirmar_modelo: I found a display on {device} that looks like a {model} (beta). If it's yours, confirm it in the tray icon menu to try it.
pantallas.modelo_equivocado: The display on {device} doesn't answer like a {model}: it doesn't seem to be that model. I've closed the port. Try another one under “Display” > “Choose model and port”.
pantallas.no_contesta: The display on {device} isn't answering yet. I'll keep trying.
pantallas.no_compatible: I found a {model} on {device}, but Luzeira doesn't support that model yet, so I'm not sending it anything. If you connect another supported display, I'll use it automatically.
pantallas.elegir_modelo: I found a {model} on {device}, but I don't know its size, so I'm not sending it anything. If it's yours, choose it with its size in “Display” > “Choose model and port”.
pantallas.no_despierta: The display on {device} isn't waking up. I'll keep trying; if it doesn't work, unplug it and plug it back in.
pantallas.elegida_no_esta: I can't find the display you chose. Is it connected via USB?
pantallas.no_encuentro: I can't find the display. Is it connected via USB?
pantallas.no_puedo_abrir_reintento: I can't open the display ({device}). I'll keep trying.
pantallas.conexion_perdida: The connection to the display was lost. Was the USB cable unplugged?
pantallas.imagen_cortada: The image was cut off halfway and the display may still be waiting for the rest. Unplug it and plug it back in: I'll try again as soon as you reconnect it or, otherwise, in a little while.
pantallas.estado_desenchufar: The display isn't responding after many attempts. Unplug it and plug it back in; meanwhile, I'll keep trying every now and then.
pantallas.estado_conectando: Display found. Getting the image ready…
pantallas.estado_en_reposo: Display off while the computer is asleep.
pantallas.estado_reintentando: I'll keep trying every few seconds.
pantallas.estado_error: Luzeira hit an unexpected error and stopped. Open it again; if it keeps happening, let us know. (Internal error: {kind})
pantallas.estado_tema_error_interno: The theme “{theme}” can't be used (internal error: {kind}).
pantallas.estado_mostrando_con_error: Showing the theme “{theme}”. {error} Keeping the previous one.
